source_bodies: GOV.UK content API metadata responses only; never download linked PDF attachments
identity_policy: publication URL plus source attachment ID; fall back to exact attachment URL when an ID is absent
date_policy: Publication-page dates remain publication-page dates; do not infer PDF publication or legal commencement
missing_policy: An unavailable or unvisited publication makes document presence unknown, never removed
content_policy: Matching metadata and URLs do not establish unchanged PDF bytes; fresh content hashes remain unknown
publication_policy: Preserve old snapshots and bindings; review impact before separate acquisition, semantic rebuild or published version change
